Third-party notices — Z Privacy V1
==================================

Z Privacy itself is licensed under the Apache License 2.0; its text is in
../LICENSE. This archive also carries work by other people. Each one is listed
here with the licence it travels under, and its full text is beside this file.

This is not a NOTICE file in the sense of Apache-2.0 §4(d). That section asks
for one only when a dependency we redistribute carries its own, and none of the
142 crates does. These are attribution notices, which the BSD and CC licences
below do require when a binary is redistributed.

  Flutter engine and framework
    Copyright 2014 The Flutter Authors — BSD-3-Clause
    Shipped as lib/libflutter_linux_gtk.so and the Dart runtime inside it.
    flutter-sdk-LICENSE.txt      the licence itself
    flutter-engine-LICENSE.txt   the engine's own aggregated notices for
                                 everything built into it (30,200 lines)

  Material Icons
    Copyright Google — Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
    Shipped as data/flutter_assets/fonts/MaterialIcons-Regular.otf
    material-icons-LICENSE.txt

  DejaVu Sans
    Copyright 2003 Bitstream, Inc. — Bitstream Vera Fonts Copyright;
    the DejaVu project's own changes are in the public domain.
    Shipped as data/flutter_assets/assets/fonts/DejaVuSans.ttf (759,720 bytes)
    and embedded, as a subset, in every PDF that «Save as PDF» writes —
    without it a saved file would promise Helvetica and lose every letter that
    is not plain ASCII. Chosen over a smaller face because it also carries
    Arabic, so the same one file will serve when that pack lands; the writer
    sets no text direction yet, so Arabic is not supported today.
    dejavu-LICENSE.txt

  dart_pdf (the `pdf` package)
    Copyright 2017 David PHAM-VAN — Apache-2.0
    Pure Dart, compiled into data/app.so with the rest of the UI; it adds no
    shared library to this archive. It is the only thing in the product that
    writes a PDF; reading one is the core's own code.
    dart-pdf-LICENSE.txt

  Rust crates
    142 packages compiled into lib/libz_bridge.so, listed with the licence
    each one states.
    rust-crates.txt

  file_selector_linux
    Copyright 2013 The Flutter Authors — BSD-3-Clause
    Shipped as lib/libfile_selector_linux_plugin.so; covered by
    flutter-sdk-LICENSE.txt, which is the same licence and the same authors.

Nothing here reaches the network on its own. The one HTTP client in the
product is `ureq`, in the core, and it speaks only to the AI provider you
connect yourself.

`pdf` brings eleven Dart packages with it (archive, barcode, bidi, crypto,
ffi, image, path_parsing, petitparser, posix, qr, xml). None speaks a
protocol. Two of them — posix and ffi — call libc, and they arrive under
`archive`, which `pdf` imports on the **web** target only: on Linux it
deflates with dart:io's own zlib, so nothing in the saving path reaches
either one. They are listed because they are in the dependency tree, not
because they run.
